scope: bounded exposed-development diagnosis; no core-method or confirmation claim

frozen_intervention.gradient: existing p2dir_readout_v1 zero-leaf autograd.grad; float64 tangent projection and normalization; float32 return
frozen_intervention.localizer: unchanged max_attention_window 50 frames (1.0 s), maximum current-query frozen alignment-head mass, earliest tie

provider.language_id_source: model generation_config.lang_to_id; sorted unique integer values
provider.mapping_digest_encoding: UTF-8 JSON of sorted [[language_token, integer_id], ...] pairs with separators (",", ":") and no whitespace
provider.null_provider: native_lid on an all-zero float32 waveform of 480000 samples at 16 kHz
provider.mapping_digest_algorithm: sha256(UTF8(json.dumps(sorted((str(language),int(id)) for language,id in lang_to_id.items()), separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False)))

population.join: unique (utterance_id,t,absolute query), retain original ordered keys and old E grouping

T0.windows: for W=[s0,s1), n=min(8000,s1-s0): L=[s0,s0+n), C=[floor((s0+s1-n)/2),floor((s0+s1-n)/2)+n), R=[s1-n,s1); all half-open
T0.attention: float64 frozen-head mean, truncate/normalize exactly as max_attention_window; integrate mass with frame/sample overlap divided by actual heard portion of each frame
T0.tie: exact maximum, first in L,C,R order; no tolerance tie
T0.E_ctx: mean of other two candidate E values
T0.reuse: E_1s and CENTER from audited P2-SEL-E; no long/center/null LID rerun when hash/bounds/provider identical

bootstrap.unit: 20 sorted dialogue IDs sampled with replacement, shared draws
bootstrap.statistic: dialogue-equal within-group means/rates; omit empty cells per group

TOKEN_LOCALIZATION_SUPPORTED.ZH_FP: at least 4/5 with E_tok<=0.10 and E_1s-E_tok>=0.25, spanning >=3 dialogues
TOKEN_LOCALIZATION_SUPPORTED.EN_TP: at least 34/42 with E_tok>=0.20, spanning >=3 dialogues
TOKEN_LOCALIZATION_SUPPORTED.separation: dialogue-equal mean E_tok(EN_TP)-E_tok(ZH_FP)>=0.25 and one-sided 80% bootstrap lower>0

CONTEXT_CONTRAST_ONLY.ZH_FP: at least 4/5 with C_tokctx<=-0.25 across >=3 dialogues
CONTEXT_CONTRAST_ONLY.EN_TP: at least 26/42 with C_tokctx>=0 across >=3 dialogues
CONTEXT_CONTRAST_ONLY.separation: dialogue-equal mean C_tokctx(EN_TP)-C_tokctx(ZH_FP)>=0.25 and one-sided 80% bootstrap lower>0

criteria.RECALL_ONLY: at least 9/18 historical EN_FN with E_tok>=0.20 across >=3 dialogues AND TOKEN_LOCALIZATION_SUPPORTED ZH_FP suppression predicate fails
criteria.TOKEN_LID_NOT_DISCRIMINATIVE: remaining valid outcomes; no supported safe token gate or contrast; report partial predicates, do not assert proof of no signal

T0.selection_artifact: results/inference_cf/p2sel_t/t0_selection.json; audited immutable hashes/formula committed and pushed before T1

thresholds.corruption_CI_note: 90% familywise upper bound 0.10 is development-only for dialogue-clustered n=60; observed cap remains 0.05 and this does not authorize deployment/confirmation

T1.threshold_denominators: exact independently recomputed dialogue-equal C_OLD margins; 3.520/-0.195 are rounded anchors only; 2.464 is illustrative not a second cutoff
T1.EN_correct_no_regression: new-minus-old mean margin >= -1e-6 and zero new corruptions; all R_B=0 rows bitwise NONE

T2.AUTO: reuse exact cache only; no regeneration
T2.terminal: descriptive development only; STOP even favorable; no 300 run

audit.independent: no import of primary decision code; independent attention/crop/selection/bootstrap/margin/energy/metric recomputation

firewall.evaluator_timing: existing only, diagnostic only; never E_tok input

tests: current query frozen alignment-head attention and frame-overlap integration
contrast diagnostic-only and no reference/future input
exactly one branch, no contrast fallback
